title: LaggingFrame
description: Backpressure overflow notification marking a consumer as lagging on a topic. Names both the topic and the sequence watermark from which data was dropped, enabling bounded fetch recovery from REST history.

type.description: Server control frame discriminator. A text frame carrying `type` is a control frame; a text frame without it is a stream envelope.

topic.description: The topic on which the consumer has fallen behind or overflowed.

from_seq.description: The sequence watermark from which the consumer's view is incomplete.
